Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: What data we collect, why, and how to exercise your rights.
Privacy.draftNotice: Provisional page: it describes how the site works today and must be legally validated before going live.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.text: The training center, whose full identity will appear in the legal notice.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.text:
Registration: last name, first name, email, phone, age, education level, institution, requested course and message.
Contact and PFE: name, email, phone (optional), subject and message.
Account: name, email and password, stored only in an irreversibly hashed form.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.text: Handling your registration request, answering your messages and managing your account. Data is used only for these purposes.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: This site only uses strictly necessary cookies: your login session (secure cookies, not readable by scripts) and your language choice. No advertising cookie or analytics tool is installed at this time.

sections.title: Retention period
sections.text: The data retention period will be specified before going live.

sections.title: Hosting and processors
sections.text: The host and any service providers will be listed before going live.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: Under Tunisian Organic Law No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004 on the protection of personal data, you may request access to, correction or deletion of your data, and object to its processing for legitimate reasons. Write to us from the Contact page. You may also contact the National Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (INPDP).
